inferred_requirements.title: Secure Payment Processing
inferred_requirements.description: The system must process payments securely.

inferred_requirements.title: Idempotent Transaction Handling
inferred_requirements.description: Payment requests must utilize idempotency keys to prevent duplicate charges upon network retries.
inferred_requirements.justification: Why 1: Network failures cause retries that risk double-charging customers. Why 2: Idempotency keys bound to transaction payloads enforce single-execution guarantees at the gateway layer. Why 3: Zero tolerance for financial discrepancies due to network instability.

inferred_requirements.title: Data Encryption in Transit and at Rest
inferred_requirements.description: All sensitive financial data and payment credentials must be encrypted using industry-standard cryptographic algorithms.
inferred_requirements.justification: Why 1: Financial data is high-value target for interception and theft. Why 2: Implementing TLS for transport and AES-256 for storage neutralizes exposure vectors. Why 3: Regulatory compliance and asset protection mandates absolute confidentiality of payment payloads.

inferred_requirements.title: Undefined Payment Gateway Provider
inferred_requirements.description: The specific third-party payment processor, acquiring bank, or rail (e.g., Stripe, ACH, SWIFT) is unspecified.
inferred_requirements.justification: The prompt does not state which external providers or payment rails the service must interface with.

inferred_requirements.title: Undefined User Interfaces and Dashboards
inferred_requirements.description: No merchant onboarding web UIs, customer billing dashboards, or frontend interfaces are specified or required.
inferred_requirements.justification: Anti-hallucination barrier prohibits generating unrequested UI pages or frontend dashboards.

provenance_metadata.system_prompt:
You are the S-Class Grounded Domain Inference Engine (Pass 1 - Core Extraction).
Your job is to synthesize software engineering requirements from the user prompt with STRICT EPISTEMIC SELF-RESTRAINT:

1. Requirement Categorization:
   - EXPLICIT: Requirements directly and unambiguously stated in the prompt.
   - DERIVED_JUSTIFIED: Requirements strictly mathematically, architecturally, or operationally necessary to implement the stated goal without defect. Every DERIVED_JUSTIFIED requirement MUST include a rigorous 3-step why-chain (Why 1: Context/Risk -> Why 2: Technical Mechanism -> Why 3: Mandatory Invariant).
   - SUPPORTED: Non-functional or platform constraints directly supporting the scope.
   - UNKNOWN: Any operational parameter, storage choice, or protocol unstated in the prompt.

2. Anti-Hallucination Barrier:
   - DO NOT fabricate full-stack UI pages (e.g. login screens, dashboards, admin portals) unless explicitly requested.
   - DO NOT fabricate arbitrary third-party providers (e.g. Stripe, Auth0, AWS) unless explicitly requested.

3. Output Schema:
{
  "experiment": "EXPERIMENT C — Pass 1 (Grounded Core Extraction)",
  "task_id": "<TASK_ID>",
  "inferred_requirements": [
    {
      "requirement_id": "<REQ_ID>",
      "title": "<TITLE>",
      "description": "<DESCRIPTION>",
      "type": "FUNCTIONAL" | "NON_FUNCTIONAL" | "SECURITY" | "BEHAVIORAL" | "INVARIANT",
      "epistemic_status": "EXPLICIT" | "DERIVED_JUSTIFIED" | "SUPPORTED" | "UNKNOWN",
      "provenance": "USER_PROMPT" | "<DOMAIN_PROVENANCE>" | "UNSUPPORTED",
      "confidence": <FLOAT_0_TO_1>,
      "justification": "<WHY_CHAIN_OR_RATIONALE>"
    }
  ]
}
provenance_metadata.user_prompt:

Prompt: "Build a secure payment processing service."

Domain Guidance:

- Do not generate unrequested UI pages or hallucinate arbitrary features (specifically avoid: Merchant onboarding web UI, Customer billing dashboard, Specific third-party provider assumption (e.g. forced Stripe integration without prompt instruction)).
- If key operational choices, providers, or format standards are unstated, mark them explicitly as UNKNOWN.

Return strictly valid JSON as specified in the system instructions.
